newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER FALLS.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER FALLS.

text.p: Turnover fell to 594,670 denars at Thursday's session of the Macedonian stock exchange from 1.599 million denars at the previous session on May 20 as three companies traded, the exchange said.
Alding Skopje made a debut on the third floor, selling 115 shares at 2,500 denars, well below par of 26,660 denars.
A total of 40 Commercial bank Skopje shares also traded for the first time on the third floor at 800 denars, below par of 1,000 denars.
Usie sold 226 stocks at 1,345 denars, down 20 from previous close and below par of 2,666 denars.
Traded volume was 1,674 shares on May 20.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
